limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: Bundling the edit and simulation with a prohibited cleanup command caused the entire invocation to be rejected before either could run.
Deleting and then recreating the answer file took two patch calls where one in-place update would have sufficed.

limitations.quote: fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git
limitations.note: The unnecessary Git status check added no verification and made the combined command exit with an error even though the simulation passed.
